subject: Tenancy branching procurement & isolated environments (EdgeCare renewal)
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@edgecare.com>, EdgeCare Procurement <procurement@edgecare.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Tenancy branching procurement & isolated environments (EdgeCare renewal)

Hi Lena / procurement team,

Per our renewal conversation last week, EdgeCare plans to split two analytics branches off the main VPC at the start of next term and request isolation for PHI-handling workloads. High level asks: a) two new isolated VPC environments (east/west) with tenant-level encryption and KV cache isolation; b) capacity to support 350 qps burst and 8M tokens/day baseline across both sites; c) 36-month term to lock pricing and dedicated capacity.

Can you confirm procurement needs (SOW, PO timing, legal redlines)? We want to align schedule so provisioning begins the week of 2027-01-10. I've attached a draft SOW and a capacity worksheet for your team to review.

If useful, we can run a short technical deep-dive with your infra leads — suggest Tue 11/9 or Wed 11/10.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SOW-EdgeCare-Isolation-v1.pdf (application/pdf), Capacity-Matrix-EdgeCare.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@edgecare.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@edgecare.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenancy branching procurement & isolated environments (EdgeCare renewal)

Rohan — thanks for the clear outline. Procurement will need: final SOW, commercial summary, and a completed security appendix (SOC2 evidence + KMS integration notes). Our budget committee prefers 36-months if the unit pricing is fixed; otherwise we'll push for 24.

Key internal asks from my side: 1) explicit network diagram for the new isolated VPCs; 2) expected cutover window and rollback plan; 3) detailed run-rate cost delta vs current environment (monthly). Can you provide those by end of this week?

We can do Tue 11/9 10:00 PT for the technical deep-dive — Carlos will join.

—Lena

lena.ortiz@edgecare.com | +1 (617) 555-4433

Team — forwarding EdgeCare's procurement response and asks. Action items I want to divide:

- Marissa: commercial summary and fixed pricing for a 36-month term, plus a 24-month alternate. Include unit cost per token and per-enclave baseline. Need by EOD 11/5 to keep the budget committee timeline.
- Karthik: network diagram, cutover/rollback plan, and preliminary sizing (nodes per enclave) based on the attached capacity sheet. Can you size for 350 qps burst and 8M tokens/day with headroom?
- Monica: security appendix (SOC2 evidence pointers, KMS/HSM integration notes) and any additional compliance items we should include for PHI isolation.

Lena asked for Tue 11/9 10:00 PT for the tech deep-dive — please block your calendars. I'll consolidate materials and send the invite.

Thanks,
Rohan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Tenancy branching procurement & isolated environments (EdgeCare renewal)

Rohan / team — quick tech update ahead of Tue's deep-dive. Initial sizing notes:

- Proposal: 2 dedicated enclave clusters (one per region). Each cluster: 4 rtx-6000 equivalent GPUs, split across 2 nodes for redundancy. This maps to ~400 qps sustained with bursts to 600 qps using autoscale buffers and prefix caching.
- KV/prefix isolation: we'll provision tenant-specific KV namespaces with separate key wrapping in KMS — minimal perf impact but important for PHI boundaries.
- Cutover: recommended incremental traffic migration over a 48-hour window, with a feature-flagged fallback to current VPC and automatic routing to fallback model variant. Rollback window: immediate switch back within 30 minutes if latency or error thresholds exceed SLOs.
- Estimated provisioning lead time: 4 weeks from signed SOW/PO for east/west clusters; some variance if HSM integration requires customer KMS invites.

I'll join the Tue deep-dive with a network diagram and a short slide on failover flow. If Marissa can share the pricing sheet today, I can add cost-per-node estimates to the chart.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
